claim: Microsoft reported $52.4 billion of gross profit for calendar Q4 2025.
summary: As of knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04, Microsoft had not yet reported calendar Q4 2025 (FY2026 Q2) results, so neither the reporting nor the $52.4 billion gross profit figure can be established.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft reported financial results for calendar Q4 2025 (October-December 2025).
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before Microsoft's calendar Q4 2025 (FY2026 Q2) earnings release in late January 2026, so this reporting event cannot be established from known information.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's gross profit for calendar Q4 2025 was $52.4 billion.
sub_claims.note: Specific gross profit figure for period ending Dec 31, 2025 was not yet reported as of 2026-01-04 cutoff, so $52.4 billion value cannot be established from known information.
